en.headline: Police set phased Chung Yeung traffic controls from today
en.dek: Special arrangements run in multiple districts until early November to manage grave-sweeping traffic near cemeteries and columbaria.
body: Police said on Thursday that special traffic arrangements for the Chung Yeung Festival will be implemented in phases from 9 October to 8 November across several districts.

Measures include temporary road closures, prohibited zones, parking suspensions and traffic diversions near cemeteries and columbaria in Chai Wan, Pok Fu Lam, Aberdeen, Diamond Hill, Cheung Sha Wan, Tuen Mun, Kwai Tsing, Sha Tin and other areas.

In Chai Wan, a private-car and light-goods-vehicle prohibited zone applies on a section of Cape Collinson Road from 7am to 3pm daily until 8 November, with further phased closures on specified dates including this weekend.

The Transport Department has issued notices for the arrangements. Police said the measures aim to ensure smooth traffic and pedestrian safety during grave-sweeping activities. Drivers were advised to plan ahead and check for updates.

zh.headline: 警方分階段實施重陽節特別交通安排
zh.dek: 多區由周四起至11月上旬實施封路、禁區及停車限制，以便利掃墓及維持交通暢順。
body: 警方周四公佈，重陽節期間特別交通安排由10月9日起分階段實施至11月8日，涵蓋多個墳場及靈灰安置所附近地區。
措施包括臨時封路、劃定禁區、暫停泊車位及改道，涉及柴灣、薄扶林、香港仔、鑽石山、長沙灣、屯門、葵青、沙田等地。
柴灣方面，歌連臣角道一段由上午7時至下午3時列為私家車及輕型貨車禁區，直至11月8日；本周末等指定日期另有分階段封路。
運輸署已發出相關通告。警方表示，安排旨在確保掃墓期間交通暢順及行人安全，並呼籲駕駛人士預早計劃行程及留意最新資訊。
